title: DischargeSummaryExtraction
description: Structured output schema for extracting information from a discharge summary or after-visit summary document.

procedure.description: Name of the procedure or treatment that was performed. Null if not specified.

date.description: Date of the procedure or discharge. Null if not specified.

discharging_clinician.description: Name of the doctor or clinician who authored the discharge document. Null if not specified.

facility.description: Hospital, clinic, or facility name. Null if not specified.

medications.description: All medications the patient is instructed to take post-discharge. Verbatim from document.

name.description: Medication name exactly as written in the document.

dose.description: Dosage exactly as written. Null if not specified.

frequency.description: How often to take it, exactly as written. Null if not specified.

duration.description: How long to take it. Null if not specified.

notes.description: Any special instructions (e.g., 'with food', 'not with alcohol'). Null if not specified.

activity_restrictions.description: Physical activities or behaviours the patient must avoid or limit.

duration.description: How long the restriction applies. Null if not specified.

wound_care.description: Any wound care or dressing instructions. Null if not specified.

diet_instructions.description: Any dietary instructions post-discharge. Null if not specified.

with.description: Who the follow-up is with (e.g., 'GP', 'orthopedic surgeon'). Null if not specified.

timeframe.description: When the follow-up should happen (e.g., '2 weeks', 'in 10 days'). Null if not specified.

contact.description: Phone number or contact for booking. Null if not specified.

warning_signs.description: Symptoms or signs explicitly listed in the document as requiring the patient to contact their provider or seek help. CRITICAL: only include signs explicitly stated in the source document.

emergency_instructions.description: Any instructions about when to call emergency services (999/911) or go to A&E. Null if not specified.

extraction_confidence.description: Confidence level in the extraction. Use 'low' for poor-quality scans or heavily ambiguous text.

missing_critical_fields.description: List of fields that were not found but are typically expected in a discharge summary.
